basic_info.description: Transformed by April Sheldon Design, this 3BD/2BA Marina Condominium blends classic charm and modern sophistication, defined by soaring 11' ceilings, abundant natural light, and well-proportioned rooms. Oversized Palladian windows illuminate the living room and fireplace, as four large archways connect the dining room, foyer, and kitchen. Sunlit by oversized windows, the kitchen showcases quartzite counters with a full-height backsplash, touch-latch cabinetry, and an ebonized oak millwork integrating storage, and laundry. An adjacent, outdoor deck is ideal for morning coffee or afternoon grilling. The primary suite enjoys serene, treetop outlooks and shares access with the second bedroom to a south-facing sunroom overlooking the rear garden. The spa-like primary bath features a quartz double vanity, custom cabinetry, and glass-enclosed shower with rainfall fixture. A guest bath is finished in timeless marble and a decorative feature wall. Additional highlights include new windows, furnace, upgraded insulation, shared rear garden, and two-car tandem parking. Located just one block from the Palace of Fine Arts, 2375 Bay is minutes from Crissy Field, the Marina Green, and the Presidio's network of trails as well as the cafs, restaurants, and shops of Chestnut Street.
